Fury]] ====Boss-like foes==== [[Skeleton]] (Undead) *{{n}} 29 (32) [[Zoldark the Unholy]] (level 3) ==Notes== *Most of the first level can be explored without the required quest, allowing transport between the two outposts, but the quest is necessary to pass the door to the southeast near the [[Lost Note]]. *There are two routes to the first [[portal]]. Each route has a [[boulder]] trap, being rolled over by a boulder does not cause [[Death Penalty]]. *[[Rock Slide]]s occur in level 1 and 2. *Watch out for [[Poison Dart]] traps. *There are 2-3 hidden groups of [[ooze]]s on level 2, in a low-ceilinged waterway. *When you kill an "ancient" Mummy or Elemental, it will revive in two minutes. Killing the foe again does not count towards [[Dwarven Raider]] and does not yield [[loot]] or [[experience]]; however, the ancient Mummies will leave exploitable [[corpse]]s whenever they are killed. *When you have to face a large number of Stone Summit, it is possible for you to reactivate the first [[Resurrection Shrine]] which means you have to travel back through the entire length of level 2 to get back to where you were. *Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #9 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]]. {{Bug|If [[Taskmaster Bellok]] is killed and the key retrieved, then the dungeon is exited or failed, sometimes if the quest is not abandoned, Bellok will not drop the key the next time one attempts the dungeon.}} *In hard mode it is very easy to be trapped and immediately killed at the resurrection shrine adjacent to Taskmaster Bellok, often leading to a failure of the dungeon. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Vloxen Mine}} *This dungeon holds multiple references to the film [[w:Raiders of the Lost Ark|Raiders of the Lost Ark]].[http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive&oldid=371774#Trivia_Check Confirmed by] [[Emily Diehl]], on [[User talk:Emily Diehl]] **There are two tunnels through which a giant rock will come rolling from behind, which will crush allies and foes who do not move out of the way quickly. A similar trap is shown in the movie. **When approaching the [[Area Map]] in level 2 of the dungeon, which is guarded by drakes, the player character will say "Drakes. Why'd it have to be drakes?", which is a (slightly altered) quote from the movie. **Bellok is a deviation of Belloq, the name of the archeologist who is Indiana Jones' rival and who opens the Ark of the Covenant. *On second level when you enter the area with [[Zalnax]] from northwest entrance, three [[Panicked Stone Summit Dwarf|Panicked Stone Summit Dwarves]] will run past you. *The second level of this dungeon is the same map as [[Bloodstone Caves]]: Level 1 with minor changes. *The third level of this dungeon is the same map as [[Slavers' Exile]] - Justiciar Thommis's level with a few changes. ==References== {{Dungeons}} [[Category:Three level dungeons]] [[Category:References to films & tv series]]
